name: xcb-util-errors
description: XCB utility library that turns raw X11 error codes, event codes, and major/minor opcodes into human-readable names, used by compositors and debugging tools for diagnostics.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
